idea-plugin.name: CRAN Policy Submission Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Catch the CRAN Repository Policy violations before the volunteer team does

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → CRAN Policy Submission Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 25 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/cran-policy-submission-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/cran-policy-submission-lint

action.text: CRAN Policy Submission Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run CRAN Policy Submission Lint on the file in the editor
